summary: Verified 6 UI-batch fixes + GitHub-funnel backend fix on preview. Backend: 3/3 pytest passes — POST /cto/projects/add successfully created a project (installation 152797252 on polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed), server-side track_server_side fired 'repo_selected' (verified via GET /funnel/github/stats?days=7 — count went 1 → 2), and the English-only skip-notice string is present in ChatPanel.jsx (no Hinglish 'Ye simple'/'lagi' leaks). Frontend (real preview browser, 1920x900, logged in as test@aurem.dev): (1) ORA GUIDE PLACEMENT — [data-testid='ds2-advisor-guide-slot'] renders INSIDE [data-testid='ds2-advisor-real'] (advisor panel) and is NOT present inside [data-testid='chat-pane']; 5 starter buttons visible in slot; clicking a starter fires the 'aurem:starter-pick' window event with the prompt in event.detail.prompt. (2) ADVISOR TAB — clicking ds2-advisor-close collapses the panel and ds2-advisor-open (vertical 'ADVISOR' tab) becomes visible on right edge; clicking it re-opens the panel. (3) MASCOT Z-INDEX — after clearing localStorage cookie-consent keys and reloading, [data-testid='cookie-consent-banner'] renders with computed z-index=10000 and the mascot's parent div has z-index=10001; clicking [data-testid='ora-guide-mascot-avatar'] with the banner visible successfully opens [data-testid='ora-guide-bubble'] (banner does NOT swallow the click). (4) ADMIN FUNNEL STRIP — /admin/overview shows all 7 stage labels (CTA click, OAuth redirect, Callback, Linked, App install, App installed, Repo picked) and the 'overall conv' string is present. (5) SHIP SUCCESS CARD + LOOP STEPPER RESET — code-verified end-to-end: ShipSuccessCard.jsx renders when result.commitSha truthy with testids ship-success-card/-sha/-github-link; ChatPanel.jsx line 3316-3329 sets shipResult from terminal completed·ship SSE event using commit_sha/full_sha/html_url/repo/branch fields, AND loop_engine.py line 3507-3513 emits EXACTLY those five fields on _emit(COMPLETED, 'ship'); ChatPanel.jsx line 3308-3313 sets an 8-second setTimeout that nulls loopPhase (unmounting LoopStepBar) — guarded by loopTerminalRef so a new loop's UI is not disturbed. (6) ENGLISH SKIP NOTICE — verified in ChatPanel.jsx line 2868: '*⚡ This looked like a simple read-only question, so I answered it directly (Loop Mode skipped — no credits burned)…*' — no Hinglish present in the source. Did NOT run a full real ship end-to-end (1-3 min per commit, and the wiring is code-verified terminal→UI on both sides with matching field names, so ROI of an actual commit vs risk-to-testbed was low); flagged for main-agent self-test if desired.
action_items: OPTIONAL: run one real ship end-to-end on polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed to visually confirm ShipSuccessCard renders with a live SHA + GitHub link — code paths are wired correctly on both sides but a real SSE-driven render was not observed in this session.

OPTIONAL: verify Live Preview overlay by attaching a live_url to the funnel-repro project and opening the Preview tab — the [data-testid='preview-live-state-overlay'] / -live-open-newtab / -live-retry-btn testids exist in PreviewPanel.jsx (lines 533-584) but were not exercised in a browser since the current test project has no live_url configured.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx line 3308 setTimeout(8000) has no cleanup on component unmount — if the user navigates away between the terminal COMPLETED event and the 8-second dwell, the setState calls will fire on an unmounted component (React swallows the warning in prod, but logs it in dev). Consider tracking the timeout in a ref and clearing on unmount alongside shipResultPollRef.

OraGuideMascot.jsx uses inline z-index: 10001 with a code-comment mapping to CookieConsentBanner's 10000 — this cross-component coupling would be safer as a shared z-index constants file (e.g., /lib/z-index.js) so future banners at 10001 don't silently re-break the mascot.

test_ui_batch_6::test_project_add_fires_repo_selected observed 499 client-disconnected once immediately after a backend restart because GitHub App config hydration is on the async lifespan startup — a request during hydration racy-fails. Consider making services.github_app.is_configured() re-check the DB one-shot if the runtime cache is empty (cheap fallback) so first-second-after-restart requests don't fail-closed.
seed_data_creation: One transient test project 'funnel-test-<ts>' was created by test_project_add_fires_repo_selected via POST /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/add and DELETEd by the same test; verified via mongosh that no residual 'funnel-test-*' rows remain in cto_projects. Funnel repo_selected count in the last-7d window is now 2 (was 1 before test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For a real ship-flow end-to-end, use test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026!, project 'funnel-repro' (installation 152797252, repo polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed). Send a loop-mode message like 'add a comment line to README.md saying testing ship flow', approve plan when PlanApprovalCard appears, click confirm on ShipPendingCard. Assert [data-testid='ship-success-card'] appears with -sha (short 7-char SHA) and -github-link (href starts with https://github.com/polarisbuiltinc-wq/aurem-rollback-testbed/commit/). Wait ~8s more and assert LoopStepBar is no longer in DOM. Backend routes: POST /api/aurem-dev/loop/start, SSE /api/aurem-dev/loop/{id}/stream, POST /api/aurem-dev/loop/{id}/confirm. Loop can take 60-180s; SSE is the source of truth (no polling needed except as fallback). Cookie banner z-index is 10000, mascot needs to remain > 10000.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this was a verification pass for previously-shipped fixes; no new bugs surfaced. The one transient 499 during test_project_add was root-caused to a lifespan-hydration race for GitHub App config immediately post-restart (config in Mongo is correct; runtime cache hydrates on startup lifespan hook), and self-resolved on the second attempt. Flagged as a minor code-review comment for potential resilience improvement.
